subject.title: openclaw doctor should detect stale gateway lock files

question: Should maintainers rebase/adopt the linked fork PR for gateway-lock doctor coverage, or close it and replace it with a fresh narrow implementation?
rationale: The issue is valid and small, but an open conflicting PR already claims the fix, so automation should not queue a competing fix until maintainers choose the branch path.

options.title: Adopt or replace the linked fix
options.body: Rebase the existing branch if it is still useful, or close it and land a fresh narrow PR that implements the same doctor check cleanly.

options.title: Keep waiting on the linked PR
options.body: Leave the issue blocked on the contributor branch, accepting that the stale/conflicting state may continue to delay the fix.

options.title: Close the linked PR without replacement
options.body: Only choose this if maintainers decide the runtime stale-lock recovery is enough and doctor coverage is no longer wanted.

recommendation.title: Adopt or replace the linked fix
recommendation.body: Rebase the existing branch if it is still useful, or close it and land a fresh narrow PR that implements the same doctor check cleanly.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is the clearest routing owner from gateway-lock introduction, stale-lock hardening, and doctor orchestration history.
